finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; pooled and donor advantage is excluded under both. Uniform advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and uniform useful advantages are excluded under both methods, with worse performance at zero only under writer resampling. Residual pooled useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed resampling; both intervals include zero. Raw sums retain useful base uncertainty under both methods and pooled and donor uncertainty only under crossed resampling; all raw model-rival intervals include zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Previously selected model prose reflects suggestion supply and prior choices, not human-authored text or necessarily final retained wording. Sparse histories, transferred calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, human-only language-learning claim, epoch/corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
